problem:
Consider the matrix $M,$ given by

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 4 \\ 8 & 3 & 1 \\ 3 & -1 & 9\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1}$ on $M?$

feedback.problem:
Consider the matrix $A,$ given by

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 2 & 7 \\ 7 & -1 & 3 \\ 6 & 9 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{3}:=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{3}$ on $A?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The operation ${R}_{3}:=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{3}$ means that we need to multiply the third row of the matrix by $\frac{1}{3}.$

Multiplying the $3$rd row by $\frac{1}{3}$, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 2 & 7 \\ 7 & -1 & 3 \\ 6 & 9 & -3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3}:=\frac{1}{3}\cdot {R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 2 & 7 \\ 7 & -1 & 3 \\ \frac{1}{3}\cdot 6 & \frac{1}{3}\cdot 9 & \frac{1}{3}\cdot -3\end{aligned}] \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 2 & 7 \\ 7 & -1 & 3 \\ 2 & 3 & -1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
